skill.name: skill-permissions
skill.description: Analyze Claude Code skill permissions and generate allow rules for controlled authorization.
skill.summary: Review installed skills, identify command needs, and prepare permission allow rules.
skill.author: guo-yu

security_audit.summary: Most command-execution blocker hits are false positives from Markdown examples and documented blocklists. Real risk remains because the skill scans hidden Claude directories, reads and writes Claude Code settings, can grant broad allow rules, and can batch modify other skill files.

remediation.suggestion: Replace Bash(cat ~/.claude/*) and broad skill-directory rules with the narrowest exact files and commands needed for each workflow.
Show a diff and require explicit user confirmation before writing ~/.claude/settings.json. Keep a backup path in the workflow.
Remove the inject workflow or limit it to a selected skill list with a dry run and per-file confirmation.
Make dangerous defaults non-overridable, or require a separate manual review for each removed blocklist pattern.

content.value_statement: AI coding tools can ask for repeated command approvals across many skills. This skill reviews permission needs and prepares focused allow rules for Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Scans SKILL.md files for bash command patterns.
Generates permissions.allow rules from detected commands.
Shows per-skill permission summaries and suggested rules.
Can add allow rules to Claude Code settings.
Can document allow commands across installed skills.
Includes a blocklist for dangerous command patterns.
limitations: It does not prove that detected commands are safe.
Batch modes can modify many skill files or settings.
Markdown examples can be mistaken for real command needs.
Permission changes may require a new Claude Code session.

use_cases.title: Review a New Skill
use_cases.description: Check one installed skill before granting command permissions.

use_cases.title: Prepare Team Approval Rules
use_cases.description: Summarize required permissions before sharing a skill with teammates.

use_cases.title: Audit Installed Skills
use_cases.description: List command patterns across a local skill directory before cleanup.

prompt_templates.title: Audit One Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use skill-permissions to review the permissions needed by the port-allocator skill. Show detected commands and suggested allow rules.

prompt_templates.title: Authorize One Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Controlled permission update for one named skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use skill-permissions to authorize only the share-skill skill. Preserve existing permission settings and show what changed.

prompt_templates.title: Review All Skills
prompt_templates.scenario: Audit every installed skill before granting permissions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use skill-permissions to scan every installed skill. Group permissions by skill and flag broad rules before any write.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Controlled Rollout
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced rollout planning for shared environments.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use skill-permissions to compare current permissions with generated rules. Create a staged approval plan and avoid batch injection.

output_examples.output: The result lists detected file discovery, directory listing, hidden Claude config reads, and local port inspection needs.

output_examples.input: Authorize permissions for one named skill.
output: The changed settings file is named in the result.

output_examples.output: The result groups skills by command needs and marks broad or blocked patterns before authorization.

best_practices: Run analysis before any authorization command.
Prefer one named skill over all-skill batch changes.
Review broad hidden-directory rules before accepting them.
anti_patterns: Do not run batch injection before reviewing affected skills.
Do not allow broad command patterns for unknown skills.
Do not treat generated allow rules as a security review.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It scans skill instructions for command patterns and creates suggested Claude Code permission rules.

faq.question: Can it change my settings?
faq.answer: Yes. Authorization commands can write to the Claude Code settings file.

faq.question: Does it execute detected commands?
faq.answer: The documented workflow analyzes commands and writes permission rules. It should not run detected task commands directly.

faq.question: Is allow-all recommended?
faq.answer: No. Use one-skill authorization when possible and review every generated rule first.

faq.question: Can it modify other skills?
faq.answer: Yes. The inject workflow can append allow instructions to many skill files.

faq.question: Who should use it?
faq.answer: Use it when you understand Claude Code permissions and can review local configuration changes.
